propositions: The gate matches bare attribute names globally across src/rebar instead of resolving reads to their owning dataclass, causing fields with non-unique names to pass when any other config has a same-named attribute read anywhere in the tree

The synthetic instance CodeHealthConfig.enabled had zero read sites yet passed the gate because .enabled was read on unrelated configs (UiConfig.enabled, McpConfig.auth_enabled, etc.), demonstrating the defect enables common field names like enabled, path, timeout to evade inert-field detection

The fix must resolve each read's receiver expression to its declaring schema class through six binding routes (section attributes, annotations, local assignments, return types, branches, cross-module call sites) so a field is satisfied only by reads of that class's instance

Four newly-flagged fields (McpConfig.readonly, McpConfig.allow_llm, McpConfig.allow_jira_sync, JiraConfig.allow_insecure) are live and read through indirection or within excluded plumbing files, requiring accurate # read-via: markers rather than deletion

The fix must include RED-first tests that freeze the pre-fix algorithm and prove it passes an inert field with a reused name while the corrected gate fires it, and tests must pin existing negative fixtures (ReconcilerConfig.lock_lease_secs, VerifyConfig gate-enabled cases) so they continue passing with their markers
The gate must report any # read-via: marker pointing to a closed tracking ticket id so parked exemptions surface rather than becoming permanent by default
